title: Zielinski et al. (2019) recombinant human insulin process — evidence replay
description: A single standalone instance of the Zielinski process model in evidence_replay mode. There are no connections: COMPOSITION_AUDIT.md section 6.3 explains why none is offered. This graph exists so the 3D replay scene can obtain the model's genuine outputs through the verified composition interface.
source_ref: Zielinski et al. 2019, Protein Expression and Purification 157 (2019) 63-69, doi:10.1016/j.pep.2019.02.002
notes: Evidence replay is not a simulation. The model restates the paper's reported numbers, applies the accounting identities the paper supports, and publishes the Fig. 3 digitized growth trajectory with its declared uncertainty. It reports no kinetic parameter, no oxygen transfer and no spatial field, so nothing downstream of this graph may present a simulated concentration, velocity or temperature field.

instances.label: Recombinant human insulin process
instances.notes: Runs on its own terms, exactly as it does in brass_batch_chain.json.
